data.name: Velo Victory
data.detailed_description:
Velo Victory is a new, realistic cycling management simulation that brings Football Manager–style depth to professional cycling. Build your legacy as a team manager by making smart decisions in scouting, transfers, facilities, contracts, staff management, and long-term planning. Every choice matters, from negotiating sponsor goals to developing future champions.

Discover your talent • Develop faster • Celebrate victory 🏆

Managing a cycling team is more than race results. It’s about planning seasons, handling personalities, balancing resources, and shaping careers. With realism tuned by heritage in cycling ratings, Velo Victory delivers the management experience cycling fans have always wanted.

  • Youth & Development squads – Manage not only your pro riders but also staff and young talents. Shape their growth and prepare them for the future.

  • Facilities management – Upgrade and maintain areas such as Merchandise, Marketing, R&D (equipment), Medical, Training, and Scouting. Each facility requires investment but strengthens your possibilities in the long run.

  • Deep scouting system – Discover hidden gems in the lowest tiers of cycling and face real challenges in signing the biggest prospects.

  • Immersive transfers & contracts – Real-time, dynamic competition with other teams for signings and detailed contract clauses make building a team more strategic than ever.

  • Personalities matter – Riders and staff bring ambitions and sensitivities that require the right approach from you as a manager.

  • Race tactics & roles – Simulations emphasize team roles and tactical choices, where your decisions before and during the stage can tip the balance between victory and defeat.

  • Sponsor-driven career – Your season goals are tied directly to your budget. Succeed, and your power on the market grows. Fail, and your options shrink.

Every season is a test of balance and vision. Expanding Training or Medical boosts performance, while Marketing and Merchandise unlock new revenue streams. R&D makes the newest and most advanced equipment models available, and improved Scouting uncovers the next talent. Each choice demands careful thought, but the right investments will lead your team to victory.

Sponsors are the foundation of your team. Their objectives set your budget and help steer the course of your season. You don’t just accept objectives, you negotiate them, balancing your sponsor’s ambitions with the realistic limits of your team. Outperform expectations to gain more financial possibilities, while failure will put you under pressure to make tough choices.

People make the difference. Riders and staff bring their own personalities, ambitions, and sensitivities, demanding a manager who can find the right approach at the right moment. Conflicts may arise, motivation can dip, or ambition might clash with team goals. How you handle these situations defines your quality as a cycling manager. Understanding when to push, when to support, and when to compromise is key to building harmony and long-term success. Sometimes even history comes alive: brothers reunited in the same jersey, or father and son chasing victory together. 

Velo Victory puts the spotlight on what matters most in a sports sim: meaningful management decisions. From scouting hidden talents and making the right tactical decisions to handling rider personalities and navigating sponsor demands, every choice shapes the path of your team.

Wishlist Velo Victory today and be part of a new era of cycling management.

data.short_description: Velo Victory is a new cycling management PC game. Build your legacy through scouting, transfers, facilities, staff, and tactics. Shape future champions, meet sponsor goals and lead your team to victory.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 / AMD Radeon R5 (integrated is fine)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1920×1080 resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 1920×1080 resolution
